name: @grievancegrid/database
description: Database schema and migrations for GrievanceGrid

scripts.install:deps: echo Install JS deps from repository root: npm install --workspaces --include-workspace-root
scripts.db:seed:admin: npm run db:seed:demo && npm run db:seed:bulk && npm run db:verify
scripts.db:seed:demo:full: npm run db:seed:demo && npm run db:verify:demo
scripts.db:seed:simple:full: npm run db:seed:simple && npm run db:verify:simple
scripts.db:seed:all: npm run db:seed:demo && npm run db:seed:bulk && npm run db:verify && npm run db:verify:demo
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
